title: AQUA - A Modular Authentication Quality Modeling Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.05660v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Authentication solutions are the key design, architectural, and implementation decisions that implement authentication security controls. An example is a password-based authentication solution. While researchers often examine authentication quality, existing approaches do not distinguish which effects on quality stem from which aspect of authentication. For example, multi-factor authentication solutions tend to be less usable because they combine multiple authenticators, whereas passkeys are more secure than passwords because of properties inherent to the authenticator itself. This paper presents AQUA, a modular quality modeling framework for authentication solutions. AQUA's core idea is to decompose authentication into four interrelated concepts, enabling modular specification of authentication quality and tracing quality effects back to their source. We demonstrate AQUA with initial definitional quality models that address the levels

translated_title: AQUA——一个模块化的认证质量建模框架
translated_abstract: 认证解决方案是实现认证安全控制的关键设计、架构与实现决策，例如基于密码的认证解决方案。尽管研究人员经常研究认证质量，但现有方法无法区分对质量的影响究竟源自认证的哪个方面。例如，多因素认证解决方案由于组合了多个认证器而往往可用性较低，而通行密钥之所以比密码更安全，则是源于认证器本身的固有属性。本文提出了AQUA，一个面向认证解决方案的模块化质量建模框架。AQUA的核心思想是将认证分解为四个相互关联的概念，从而实现认证质量的模块化规范定义，并能将质量影响追溯至其来源。我们通过初步的定义性质量模型对AQUA进行了演示，这些模型涵盖了各个层级。
tldr: 本文提出AQUA框架，通过将认证分解为四个相互关联的概念，实现对认证解决方案质量的模块化建模，并能将质量影响追溯至其具体来源。
en_tdlr: This paper presents AQUA, a modular quality modeling framework that decomposes authentication into four interrelated concepts, enabling modular specification of authentication quality and tracing of quality effects back to their source.
